name: ConsultBae - duplicate alert on a new CSV

nodes.name: Webhook: CSV arrives
nodes.notes: POST a multipart form with the CSV as field 'file'. Swap this node for a Gmail or Google Drive trigger and nothing downstream changes - that is the point of keeping the parsing in the next node rather than in the trigger.

nodes.name: Check against the database
nodes.notes: The API re-normalises every value through pipeline.normalize and applies the same match order as the merge pipeline: exact email, exact phone, then name+city as a REVIEW signal only. It also writes an automation_events row, so the alert is reconstructable afterwards.

nodes.name: Anything to flag?
nodes.notes: Branches on needs_attention (duplicates OR review cases), not on duplicates alone. A row whose phone could not be parsed is not a clean pass - it is an unanswered question.

nodes.name: Slack: duplicate alert
nodes.notes: continueOnFail: if Slack is down the webhook must still answer the caller. An alerting channel that takes the whole flow with it is worse than no alerting channel. Needs a Slack credential; the email node below is the no-credential alternative.

nodes.name: Email: duplicate alert
nodes.notes: Disabled by default so the workflow imports and runs without SMTP credentials. Enable either this or the Slack node.

nodes.name: Respond to caller
nodes.notes: Answers on both branches. Whoever uploaded the file gets the verdict synchronously instead of having to go and look in Slack.
